review.assessment: The change in `config.mjs` corrects the argument order passed to `merge`, ensuring user settings take precedence over defaults instead of being overwritten by them. The updated logic in `merge.mjs` replaces the shallow spread operator with a recursive deep merge: it iterates only over keys provided by the override object and merges nested objects while copying all other keys from the base (defaults). This correctly layers the settings so that user-provided values replace defaults, sibling fields are preserved during nesting, and default keys absent in the user config remain intact.
